doc: Every piece of game content the mashup uses: where the extractor finds it in the player's own install, where it goes in the cache, and what the mod shows if it can't be read. Nothing here is ever shipped.

locator.doc: primary way the extractor finds it in the player's install

maxTris.doc: triangle budget after decimation (0 for non-mesh)

placeholder.doc: what the mod shows when extraction failed (shipped in the jar, original art)
